title: Palette assignment (v2)
description: Peer schema (cycle 34 Branch A) that extends v1 with a discriminated union on pinned_state.format ∈ {v1_flat, v2_iterated_params}. v1_flat is backwards-compatible with c31 palette_v1; v2_iterated_params carries the P1 (get_parameter(i)-iterate) format uncovered by c33 Branch B, unblocking Surge XT + Dexed as palette-render-eligible instruments. assignment_id_v2 uses a NEW UUID5 namespace (063eb50e-0aac-59bb-84a8-ef26540a8912) distinct from v1's. additionalProperties: false at every object level.

assignment_id_v2.description: UUID5 hex (32 lowercase hex chars) derived from canonical-JSON of (schema_v, stem, instrument, pinned_state, sorted(provenance_pointers), extractor_version) under NAMESPACE_PALETTE_V2 = uuid5(NAMESPACE_URL, 'palette_v2::music-gen::c34') = 063eb50e-0aac-59bb-84a8-ef26540a8912. notes_optional is EXCLUDED from the hash.

stem.description: Which stem this assignment addresses. 'mono' is NEW in v2 — enables VST3 instruments to serve as full-range assignments without per-stem role.

instrument.description: Instrument palette identifier. surge_xt/dexed = VST3; sfizz = SFZ sampler; fluidsynth_gm = legacy GM soundfont chain.

iterated_params.description: Strict key set: keys derived from the plugin's get_parameter_name(i) output, formatted as '<5-digit-index>:<name>'. Layer 2 enforces exact equality with the c33 P1-output anchor for plugin_name.

items.description: rule_id string that MUST resolve against data/rules/ledger.jsonl OR data/rules/ledger_i3_dminor.jsonl (Layer 2 enforced).

notes_optional.description: Free-text authoring note. EXCLUDED from assignment_id_v2 hash.
